?

a
A=∫03(x2−2x+2)dx
b
A=∫−13(x2−2x+2)dx
c
A=∫−30(x2−2x+2)dx
d
A=∫−10(−x2+2x−2)dx
e
A=∫−30(−x2+2x−2)dx
